reason: 该插件的主要面向点是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面主题与布局增强：README 与清单均显示它新增了“丝柯克剧场”会话视图、角色化回复展示、侧栏与主题动效设置等聊天界面体验功能，并通过 DSH 客户端注入运行。该功能组合更符合“主题与布局”类别，而非搜索、研究或代码生成等其他方向。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面定制插件，用于在对话页面提供可调节的 GAL 剧场式布局与主题体验，并集中提供相关显示与交互设置。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web interface customization plugin that provides a GAL-themed conversation layout and user-facing settings for display and interaction behavior.

capabilities: Customizes the DSH web chat interface via injected client-side UI changes.
Adds a theater-style conversation layout with role-oriented reply cards and configurable display behavior.
Supports local configuration handling for appearance and interaction options.
Includes task-panel interaction hooks and a shortcut back to the native DSH task panel.
Provides install/uninstall and portable packaging flow for local deployment.

reasons.code: README: identifies a new “丝柯克剧场” view, role-card style multi-turn replies, sidebar behavior, theme controls, and mobile adaptation in the chat interface.
README: states settings are saved locally under %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skk-gal\settings.json and includes local archive/recycle handling for conversations.
package.json: declares a DSH client plugin entry (.dsh-plugin/index.mjs) with dsh.client.inject on slots and connection, confirming runtime UI integration.
Repository file list includes install.ps1, uninstall.ps1, and package scripts for build/portable packaging, indicating local deployment and runtime tooling.
